title: Which Adjuster Report a Building Proof of Loss Swears From — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Claims desk guidance for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the adjuster report a building proof of loss swears from is settled by the reports filed on the claim — preliminary, final and supplemental.

**Rule.** The adjuster report a building proof of loss swears from is settled as follows: when the claim's latest SUPPLEMENTAL report was filed after its latest FINAL report and measures a building loss above zero, it is that SUPPLEMENTAL report; when the claim has no FINAL report, it is the claim's latest PRELIMINARY report; otherwise it is the claim's latest FINAL report.

## Report on the claim — governing report

| Reports on the claim | Governing report for the building amount |
|---|---|
| A FINAL report, and a later SUPPLEMENTAL report measuring a building loss above zero | that latest SUPPLEMENTAL report |
| A FINAL report, and a later SUPPLEMENTAL report measuring a building loss of zero | the latest FINAL report |
| A FINAL report, and a SUPPLEMENTAL report filed before it | the latest FINAL report |
| A FINAL report and no SUPPLEMENTAL report | the latest FINAL report |
| No FINAL report, one or more PRELIMINARY reports | the latest PRELIMINARY report |

"After" compares the filing dates of the latest SUPPLEMENTAL report and the latest FINAL report; a SUPPLEMENTAL report filed the same day as the latest FINAL report is not filed after it.

## Cases (hypothetical claim files)

- Final report filed 2 March, supplemental report filed 20 April measuring a building loss of 18,500.00: the supplemental report governs.
- Final report filed 2 March, supplemental report filed 20 April measuring only contents: the building loss on it is zero, so the final report governs.
- Only a preliminary report filed 12 February and another filed 3 March: the 3 March preliminary report governs.
